vsl_script.text:
COMMUNITY VSL. Target length 3 to 6 minutes. Adon or CC on camera, landscape, eye level, quiet room. Oasis Studio adds captions, b-roll, the screen recordings named below and the OASIS end card.
Rule for the whole video: say no number, result or member story that is not on the page. Prices are said exactly as the page shows them. Any footage of the Telegram group blurs every member's name and face unless that member agreed in writing.

[BEAT 1. HOOK, 0:00 to 0:20]
On camera: You are building something with AI, mostly alone, and every time you get stuck there is nobody to ask who has actually done it.

[BEAT 2. WHO THIS IS FOR, AND WHO IT IS NOT FOR]
On camera: This is for early builders and agencies who learn by building. It is not for you if you want it done for you. If that is you, look at COMMAND or FLEET.

[BEAT 3. WHY IT KEEPS HAPPENING]
On camera: Building alone is slow because nobody near you has shipped the thing you are stuck on. And most AI groups are people selling courses to each other, not people building.

[BEAT 4. WHAT WE DO ABOUT IT]
Voice over, with the join flow on screen: Three steps. Answer two quick questions. Leave your details and get the free link. Then build alongside us, and upgrade only when you want the room.

[BEAT 5. WHAT YOU GET, PRICES SAID OUT LOUD]
On camera, matching the page word for word:
The Telegram lounge is free.
The VIP mastermind, a weekly build room, is $47 to $97 a month.
One-on-one founder mentorship is $2,500 to $5,000 a month, by application.
Every paid plan: cancel any time from your account, no cancellation fee.
Note for the recording: once Adon picks one number for each range, say that number, and update this script and the page together.

[BEAT 6. PROOF]
No permissioned examples are confirmed yet. Show one real weekly build clip instead, with the permission of everyone visible in it.

[BEAT 7. CALL TO ACTION]
On camera: Join free below. Build alongside us for free, and upgrade only when you want the room.

items.title: Nobody to ask
items.body: You get stuck on a step, nobody around you has done it, and a fix that should take an hour takes a week.
